core_obligations: From (1) to a cover: for a base change along a morphism of algebraic stacks the proof chooses a scheme smoothly surjecting onto the test stack, where the base change is universally open and hence open on spaces (proof lines 2483-2487)

The comparison square: in the commutative square relating the two base changes the horizontal arrows are open and surjective and the induced map to the fibre product of the spaces is surjective, so openness on the cover forces the right vertical arrow to be open (proof lines 2487-2503)
The converse: the second condition implies the first once tested on base changes by schemes, which the author records as following from the definitions (proof lines 2504-2505)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：取概型 V 满光滑映到 Z，则 V ×_Y X → V 万有开（故 |·| 上开）。比较方形中两水平箭头开且满、到空间纤维积的映射满 ⇒ 左竖直箭头开 ⇒ 右竖直箭头开。
(2)⇒(1)：按定义（只沿概型基变换）即得，作者注明「follows from the definitions」。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises representable morphisms of algebraic stacks which are universally open as those whose every base change induces an open map on topological spaces (author lemma at source lines 2468-2480, label lemma-characterize-representable-universally-open). The proof (source lines 2482-2505) proves the non-trivial direction by choosing a smooth scheme cover of the test stack, where the base change is open by hypothesis, and descending openness along the comparison square whose horizontal arrows are open and surjective and whose induced map to the fibre product of spaces is surjective (proof lines 2483-2503); the converse is recorded as following from the definitions. The descent along the comparison square is the content. H2.
